reviewer: independent evaluator r4; raw source snapshots, direct Blender 4.5.15 reopen, saved views, and July 2023 Street View panorama inspected

criteria.status: TREC identity and named GIS footprint verified; wall/roof perimeter remains uncertain
evidence: Raw Purdue CampusBuilding feature OBJECTID 312 names Turf Recreation Exercise Center and uses ABBR=TREC; raw OSM way 283275002 is separately named Turf Recreation Exercise Center.
The saved wall envelope follows the 32-vertex Purdue GIS polygon (computed area 3170.2 m²). The orthophoto directly shows the red GIS and blue OSM rings on the same TREC roof.

The named GIS polygon is a reasonable authoritative choice for this facility. The imagery makes clear that it is roof-level registration evidence and does not prove that the polygon is the structural wall line.
The raw GIS area attribute (36,210 sq ft), computed GIS ring (~34,124 sq ft), Purdue Treasurer list (36,545.51 sq ft), and RecWell project area (29,037 sq ft) remain unreconciled.
findings: Retain the GIS-versus-OSM perimeter and four area figures as unresolved; no evidence supports silently converting either source outline into a surveyed wall edge.

criteria.status: GIS placement and dimensions reproduced; source registration conflict remains
evidence: Direct Blender 4.5.15 reopen confirms world bounds X -921.752..-874.594 m, Y 84.544..161.208 m. The structural envelope is about 44.84 × 74.83 m and the long axis is north-south.
The outline was placed using the documented campus-coordinate approximation and the model retains campus coordinates in the expected standalone massing library.

The selected GIS center differs from the prior OSM/manifest center by -2.38 m east-west and -0.44 m north-south; GIS is about 1.21 m narrower east-west. Both lines fall over the correct roof in the 2023 orthophoto.
findings: The identity and gross placement are strong, but the unresolved ~2.4 m horizontal offset and ~1.2 m width difference prevent full confidence in the final wall position/dimensions.

criteria.criterion: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.status: Roof form is imagery-supported and vertical profile is LiDAR-derived estimate; floors remain unverified
evidence: The orthophoto directly supports the pale two-plane roof, north-south ridge and repeated east-west transverse bands. The top and isometric views show those same major forms.
The reopen report gives eaves 9.70 m and ridge 14.40 m; both are labelled estimates, not measured elevations.

The source LiDAR analysis reports a cross-roof profile of about 9.7 m at outer bins and 14.37 m centrally above nearby classified ground. The point cloud has no class-6 returns within either outline and uses nearby ground, so it supports the broad estimated profile but not surveyed eaves.
RecWell's turf-field use supports one large clear-span interior volume, but the available sources do not establish a floor/story count.
findings: Keep both vertical datums explicitly estimated and leave floor count unverified; no published section or elevation was found.

criteria.status: TREC-specific Street View verifies the major visible-side facade elements; exact stationing and some openings are estimates
evidence: I opened the identified Google Street View panorama CKWL7p3cJEsDPH5hReovcw in Chrome; its visible capture label is July 2023. The TREC facade is directly visible with a red-brown brick base, pale vertical-rib metal above, two large service-door openings, dark wall louvers, one horizontal window and a glazed corner entrance beneath a broad light canopy.

The reopened model and rendered east-entry view reproduce those main material bands, vertical ribs, corner glazing/canopy, wall louvers, window and service doors. These details are now supported by a TREC-specific view rather than extrapolated CoRec imagery.

The 360 panorama is perspective, not a rectified elevation; dimensions and feature stationing are necessarily estimated. The model's visible long wall appears to show more service-door panels than the two clearly visible in the panorama, and unseen faces are not verified.
findings: The main facade language is now evidence-backed. Reduce or document the extra service-door panels against the panorama, and retain uncertainty for exact dimensions and the unseen sides.

criteria.criterion: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.status: Standalone asset reopened; export and evidence package are complete for this massing lane
evidence: The saved asset at modular\buildings\massing_turf_recreation_exercise_center_9622f45.blend reopens in Blender 4.5.15 with the expected scene and collection, 274 mesh objects, and 324 evaluated faces.
The validation reports no unpacked external image dependencies and confirms direct campus-coordinate massing geometry.

The dedicated audit folder includes raw GIS and OSM snapshots, official RecWell pages, 2023 orthophoto, 2018 QL2 LiDAR tile and computations, the Street View access/inspection record, orthophoto overlay, four useful rendered views, and a saved reopen-validation report.
